An''' earth warrior (elite)''' is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[earth warrior]]. If on a [[Slayer assignment]], an elite Earth warrior is guaranteed to spawn; otherwise, elite monsters have a spawn rate of 1 in 1,000. Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s.

==Names==
The elite versions have varying names, with a randomly generated prefix and suffix.
